title: Kinetics and Prognostic Value of NeuroFilament Light in Post-cardiac Arrest: A Prospective Multicenter Study
official: Kinetics and Prognostic Value of NeuroFilament Light in Post-cardiac Arrest: A Prospective Multicenter Study
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the prognostic value of absolute value and kinetic of neurofilament light chain (NFL) collected at different time points (at admission, 12h, 24h, 48h, 72h, 96h, and day 7 after ICU admission) in predicting poor and good neurological outcome in comatose patients after cardiac arrest.

interventions.name: Value of neurofilament light chain (NFL) at different time points

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients admitted to the ICU for cardiac arrest,
* Patients who regained consciousness following in-hospital or out-of-hospital cardiac arrest,
* Patients in a coma upon arrival in the ICU, defined by a Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score \<8,
* Patients included in the AfterROSC2 cohort,

Exclusion Criteria:

* Terminally ill patients (death expected within 3 hours of admission to the ICU),
* Minors,
* Patients under legal guardianship,
* Pregnant women,
* Patients not enrolled in a social security program,
* Prior inclusion in the CINEFIL study,
* Restriction of active therapies prior to the first NFL biomarker assay,
* Objection by a family member or trusted person, if present
